podcast.body: "My Hero," from "The Colour and the Shape," was inspired by Dave Grohl's belief in "ordinary heroes"—strong, respectable individuals one can relate to, rather than conventional rock or sports icons. He admired people he knew for various reasons and aspired to be like them during his youth. "Actually my hero is about having just ordinary heroes you know. When I was young I didn't have big sports heroes you know. There were bands that I liked and there were musicians that I admired but I didn't have like rock heroes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: A Japanese CD single release for "My Hero" in 1998 is noted as an example of high-quality CD single releases available outside of the UK market. "My collection contains this 1998 Japanese release for the Fufighters My Hero. It contains this cover."
